svg.title: Plain Networks and ResNet: Published CIFAR-10 Curves
svg.desc: Adapted from He et al., Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition, arXiv 1512.03385v1, Figure 6, left and middle panels. Vector paths are extracted from the authors' eps/cifar.pdf, not reconstructed from raw training logs. All published plain depths 20, 32, 44, 56 and residual depths 20, 32, 44, 56, 110 are included. Solid curves are test error; dashed curves are training error. The original zero-to-20 percent display window is preserved, including omitted early errors above the window. The mask reveals the published curves over 0 to 64,000 iterations; it does not simulate training or align initial errors. Simple formulas describe the block output after ReLU.

g.text: He et al. (2016a), Figure 6 · Left and Middle Panels
